verdict.rationale: Fellow's documented REST Developer API supports self-serve API key generation and authentication, with endpoints for recordings/transcripts (fellow-docs-4, fellow-docs-36), action items (fellow-docs-5, fellow-docs-45), and note summaries/agendas, all with pagination support — directly enabling scripts to pull transcripts, summaries, and action items. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented, no public OpenAPI spec found (fellow-probe-2 shows 404s across candidate paths), and no explicit endpoint confirmed for pulling a full meeting summary object (only action items/recordings/notes documented explicitly).
